title: QuantiFarm assessment information
description: Assessment information about cultivation on a parcel with or without DATSs

farmInformation.description: Generic information of the farm at which the parcel that is assessed is situated

parcelInformation.description: Generic information of the parcel that is assessed

datsUsed.description: List of DATSs being used on the parcel
datsUsed.$comment: if there are no DATSs used on the parcel, the array should be empty

items.description: Name of a DATS being used on the parcel
items.$comment: the name must be present in the datsInformation field of the testcase data!!

waterUsageInformation.description: Information about the usage of water during the cultivation in the specific year

fuelUsageInformation.description: Information about the usage of fuel during the cultivation in the specific year

electricityUsageInformation.description: Information about the usage of electricity during the cultivation in the specific year

fuelForTemperatureControlInformation.description: List of one or more fuels used for temperature control during the cultivation in the specific year

items.description: Usage information of a fuel for temperature control

pesticidesUsageInformation.description: List of one or more pesticides used during the cultivation in the specific year

items.description: Usage information of a pesticide used on the parcel

fertilizersUsageInformation.description: List of one or more fertilizers used during the cultivation in the specific year

items.description: Usage information of a fertilizer used on the parcel

feedUsageInformation.description: List of one or more feeds used during the cultivation in the specific year

items.description: Usage information of a feed used on the parcel

drugsUsageInformation.description: List of one or more drugs used during the cultivation in the specific year

items.description: Usage information of a drug used on the parcel

labourInformation.description: Information about the amount of labour used for various tasks during the cultivation in the specific year

economicInformation.description: Economic information about the performance of the cultivation in the specific year

outputInformation.description: Information about the output production of the cultivation in the specific year

additionalAnimalInformation.description: Additional animal information that influences the assessment of the performance of the cultivation in the specific year

additionalLabourInformation.description: Additional labour-related information that influences the assessment of the performance of the cultivation in the specific year

additionalFieldsInformation.description: Additional fields information of any kind

items.description: Additional field information of any kind
